name: Rainbow Icon
description: Cycles selected parts of your icon through RGB with optional glow.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Turn the rainbow effect on or off.

speed.name: Speed (cycles per second)
speed.description: How fast the hue cycles. 0.3 is roughly one full loop every 3 seconds.

target.name: Affect
target.description: Choose which part of the icon receives the rainbow effect.

palette-sync.name: Sync nearest palette color (Globed, experimental)
palette-sync.description: Also sets your real saved Color 2 + glow to the closest palette color. Your original color is restored when you turn this off.
